about_the_game:
Welcome to the Beauty Store Simulator Demo! Step into the glamorous world of cosmetics and fashion, and get a first look at managing your very own beauty retail dream. In this free trial version, you can:

  • Create Your Boutique:

    Use a variety of tools and decorations to design and customize your unique retail space.

  • Manage Basic Inventory:

    Stock and display a wide range of makeup, skincare, jewelry, and fashion accessories.

  • Serve Your First Customers:

    Learn the basics of welcoming shoppers, recommending products, and handling checkout.

  • Experience Core Gameplay:

    Get a taste of the unique fun of beauty retail simulation and lay the foundation for your business empire.

This is only the beginning! The full version of the game will offer a much deeper and more realistic management experience with additional strategic challenges.

Full Game Features (Coming Soon)

While the demo introduces you to the basics of store operations, the full game will unlock a suite of advanced management tools to transform your shop from a simple store into a highly efficient, secure, and trendy retail empire!

Look forward to these powerful features:

  • 🎬 Influencer & Streamer Hires:

    Boost traffic and sales by collaborating with popular beauty influencers for live streaming events.

  • 🧹 Professional Cleaning:

    Hire janitors to maintain a spotless store environment, enhancing your brand image and customer satisfaction.

  • 👮♂️ Security Measures:

    Deal with occasional pickpockets by hiring security guards to patrol your store and protect your merchandise.

  • 🚚 Efficient Restocking:

    Employ restock assistants to automatically keep shelves full and organized, ensuring you never miss a sale.

  • 💻 Automated Checkout:

    Recruit assistant managers to handle transactions, reduce wait times, and even upsell products for a smoother customer experience.

  • 💇‍♀️ Salon & Spa Management:

    Expand your beauty empire with barbershop and massage parlor operations — offer premium grooming and relaxation services to attract high-end clientele and diversify your income streams.

Download the demo now to start planning your business strategy—and get ready to expand when the full game releases!
